'''FC Vysočina Jihlava''' is a [[association football|football]] club from [[Jihlava]], Czech Republic, which plays in the [[Czech National Football League]] (second tier). The club played in the [[Czech First League]] for the first time in its history in the [[2005–06 Czech First League|2005–06 season]], and also played in the league for six seasons between 2012 and 2018."}}
